Rate Contract AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 10. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 11. Rate Contract Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they dont upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 12. Rate Contract Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support.
